item: Review fixes - complete strict five-framework qualification

frameworks.label: Fict

artifactArchive.scope: Frozen HTML, source/config/lockfiles, production bundles, shared CSS and executed harness JavaScript. Installed dependencies are identified by the captured locks and previous reference build provenance; no claim of latest upstream versions.

method.roundA: Nine cases in ascending order, one invocation for all five entries; harness sorts entries in Fict/React/Solid/Svelte/Vue order.
method.roundB: Nine cases in descending order; a separate single-framework invocation for each case in Vue/Svelte/Solid/React/Fict order.
method.measurement: Official harness total durations including browser rendering, plus script and paint components. Source/lock/config/local and HTTP bundle hashes verified; all five official keyed checks pass.
method.isolation: No task builds, tests, profiling or other timing runs overlap the CPU batches. Ordinary operating-system and desktop activity is not disabled.
method.uncertainty: Two complete rounds and every reported sample are retained. Per-round score variation is descriptive, not a confidence interval, and does not control all host/thermal variation. No isolated async-overhead or causal before/after claim is made from historical 0.34.0 measurements.

memory.unit: MiB of whole-page memory after forced GC, not JS heap-only bytes

aggregation.normalization: For each case divide a framework arithmetic mean by the fastest mean among these five measured entries; take the geometric mean across the nine equally weighted CPU cases. Pool equal-size rounds at the case-mean level before normalization.
